blocks.text: Cloud computing and blockchain keep evolving. This section explores promising advances: edge computing and serverless architectures in the cloud, and Blockchain 2.0 and integration with AI and IoT.

blocks.alt: Top: a supply chain of supplier, manufacturer, fabricator, intermediary, retailer and customer, each hand-over linked to a record on a shared ledger line. Bottom left: plain text passes through encryption with a key to cipher text and back through decryption with a key, beside the sealed-letter analogy. Bottom right: edge computing, serverless, Blockchain 2.0, AI plus blockchain and IoT plus blockchain with one-line notes.
blocks.caption: Product tracking, encryption and future trends (original diagram after topics 6.5 and 6.6).
blocks.long_description: A product such as chocolate passes from supplier to manufacturer, fabricator, intermediary, retailer and customer, and each hand-over is recorded on the shared ledger, so the customer can trace the product's origin. Encryption turns readable plain text into cipher text with a key, and decryption with the right key turns it back; with digital signatures, a recording network and many copies, this keeps blockchain data hard to read, forge or change. Future trends include edge computing near data sources, serverless computing, Blockchain 2.0 with smart contracts and decentralized apps, and blockchain combined with AI and IoT.
